# Radhvan ScaleTech

> Strategic IT Solutions for a Digital World. IT Consulting, Custom Web Development, AI Automation, and Search Visibility (SEO, GEO, AEO) by Omendra Bhada.

## About Omendra Bhada
Omendra Bhada is an IT Consultant, Web Developer, and Digital Solutions Architect with over 20+ years of technology experience. He is the Founder of Radhvan ScaleTech (core technology and digital consulting practice) and Founder of Radhvan Origins (functional wellness & biotechnology venture).

## Services Offered
1. **IT Consulting & Technical Strategy**: Cloud architecture, infrastructure scaling, systems administration, and pragmatic technology stack selection.
2. **Custom Web Development & Engineering**: Fast, mobile-responsive, semantic, conversion-focused websites and web applications.
3. **AI & Workflow Automation**: CRM integrations, automated lead capture and routing, AI-driven customer response systems.
4. **SEO, GEO & AEO Optimization**: Search Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization for LLM citations, and Answer Engine Optimization for voice & conversational search.
